Brace yourself, Taurus—this week the heavens brew a love‑fueled upheaval.

Monday, Venus trines your 5th House, sparking romance as an earth sign deepens sensuality. Tuesday, Mercury sextiles Jupiter in your 2nd House, smoothing money talks and spotting income chances. Wednesday, Sun square Saturn in your 10th House raises career doubts, making it week’s toughest day. Thursday, Mars stations direct in your 1st House, blasting fog and igniting drive. This shift restores confidence and sets weekend up for progress. Through Saturday, the Sun moves into your 7th House, highlighting partnerships. Sunday’s Mercury sextile Neptune sparks ideas, stay grounded. Overall the weekend favors dating, socializing, collaboration. Best day: Thursday, when Mars powers your 1st House, fueling new starts and momentum. Worst day: Wednesday, Sun square Saturn strains career ambitions and raises doubts. Take a concrete action toward a financial goal on Tuesday to cash in Mercury–Jupiter boost. Follow for daily updates.
